name: HTF PO3 + RSI Divergence V2 MTF
description: Port MQL5 'HTF PO3 + RSI Divergence' v1.07 (Hammad Dilber). RSI dihitung di H1 via security() (closed bars, no-lookahead, cached per nilai parameter). Pivot high/low RSI (lbL/lbR bar H1) → regular bullish/bearish divergence: polyline lime/red di chart, BUY/SELL arrow offset ATR(14)*0.5 dengan filter RSI<=45 / >=55, label Bull/Bear Div. Parameter: htf, rsiLen, rsiBuyLv, rsiSellLv, lbL, lbR, win.
